Thanks Nikhil — that helps. A couple quick follow-ups from AP: 

1) For EU reverse charge: StellarOS will apply reverse-charge when we receive sufficient supplier evidence. Would Redwood be able to confirm in writing that no VAT was charged on the invoice and provide the US tax ID on each invoice?
2) Our ERP requires the customer-created PO to include an explicit billing contact email for the supplier (so our AP can route remittance advices). Can you confirm invoices@redwood.com is acceptable?
3) We use a 30-day payment term and prefer PO lines to include a SKU-like short code (we can populate that if you provide a short description mapping).

If you can return a one-page "supplier confirmation" statement we can keep in our vendor file to speed the first payment. Otherwise our AP team will request additional follow-ups.

Regards,
